Hi Rachel — welcome, and thanks for the attachments.

Quick checklist so we can get this moved into our vendor master: 
- Please complete and return our Master Vendor Form (attached) with the exact legal name as it should appear on the record.
- Confirm the tax jurisdiction (state) for the EIN on the W-9.
- Provide a copy of the corporate registration or articles of incorporation if the W-9 legal name differs from the trading name.
- If remittance address differs from the corporate address, please indicate both and specify which one should receive checks.

I attached the MasterVendorForm.docx and a short DocuSign link for e-sign if that is easier: https://docusign.example.com/starlite-redwood-vendor (fillable fields: legal name, tax id, remit address, AP contact, preferred invoice method).

Tentative timeline: once we receive the completed form and bank details, Finance typically validates in 3 business days and then we can route the first PO. If there's anything unusual (e.g., parent company bank account) that can add verification time.

Looping in Marissa for any legal name checks and Ben for finance verification so they're aware.

Hi all — small legal note on entity naming to speed verification: please ensure the legal name on the vendor profile exactly matches the name on the W-9 and articles of incorporation (including punctuation and suffixes). If you operate under a DBA, provide a notarized DBA filing or certificate of fictitious name.

Also for Finance: if Starlite's bank account is held by a parent entity, we'll need an authorization letter from the parent and a voided check for the account they want payments wired to.

Rachel — when you return the MasterVendorForm, include: legal name, registered address, remit address, EIN, primary AP contact, invoice routing (email or EDI), and a contact for PO-related queries (name/email/phone). That will allow Ben to create the record with a full remit/PO routing profile.

If anything looks off when we ingest the W-9 vs the form, we'll reach out immediately.

Thanks,
